verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents self-hosting via a one-line Docker run ([qdrant-docs-1]) and deployment on any infrastructure, including GPU setup ([qdrant-docs-23]). It also covers distributed multi-node mode ([qdrant-docs-5]), Private Cloud on any Kubernetes ([qdrant-docs-15]) and an embedded Edge variant ([qdrant-docs-10]). Independent users corroborate this: they cite the Apache-2.0 license ([qdrant-comm-7]), building from source in about 30 minutes with small portable binaries ([qdrant-comm-9]), running it in production for over a year ([qdrant-comm-5]), and an easy in-memory mode for POCs ([qdrant-comm-4]).
